name: Juicero
title: Was Juicero too early? No: the press was not needed
question: Was Juicero too early?
answer: Juicero raised $120M for an internet-connected juice press priced at $699, later $399, that squeezed proprietary packs. In 2017 reporters showed the packs could be squeezed by hand about as well, and the company shut down that September. No future enabler fixes a product the customer does not need.
verdict_reason: The packs could be squeezed by hand; no enabler fixes that.

constraint.name: Nothing was missing
constraint.detail: The enablers it needed already existed; something else killed it.
